from harness import *
H=[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[["a","b"]]}]
# G: close and timeout at the same time
d = doc(timeout_ms=5, cases=[case('a',H)], events=[{"at":5,"kind":"close"}])
o = chk('close ties timeout', d, expect_error=False)
print('   ', [(c['state'],c['at']) for c in o['cases']])   # expect closed at 5
# end event before close at the same time
d = doc(timeout_ms=50, cases=[case('a',H)],
        events=[{"at":5,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[],"end":True},{"at":5,"kind":"close"}])
o = chk('end then close same time', d, expect_error=False)
print('   ', [(c['state'],c['at'],c['response_frames']) for c in o['cases']])  # ok at 5
# close before end at the same time
d = doc(timeout_ms=50, cases=[case('a',H)],
        events=[{"at":5,"kind":"close"},{"at":5,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[],"end":True}])
o = chk('close then end same time', d, expect_error=False)
print('   ', [(c['state'],c['at'],c['response_frames'],c['received']['n']) for c in o['cases']])  # closed at 5, 0 frames
# two closes at the same time
d = doc(timeout_ms=50, cases=[case('a',H)], events=[{"at":5,"kind":"close"},{"at":5,"kind":"close"}])
o = chk('two closes same time', d, expect_error=False)
print('   ', [(c['state'],c['at']) for c in o['cases']])
# pause completion and close at same time (close first -> no emission)
d = doc(timeout_ms=50, cases=[case('a',[{"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":5},{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[["a","b"]],"End_Stream":True}])],
        events=[{"at":5,"kind":"close"}])
o = chk('close vs pause', d, expect_error=False)
print('   ', [(c['state'],c['at'],c['frames']) for c in o['cases']])
# timeout at same time as a data event that does not end -> timeout wins (event accepted, then timeout)
d = doc(timeout_ms=5, cases=[case('a',H)], events=[{"at":5,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"x","end":False}])
o = chk('non-end event ties timeout', d, expect_error=False)
print('   ', [(c['state'],c['at'],c['response_frames'],c['received']['n']) for c in o['cases']])
